labels.shortDescription: Import: one object's reason; {0} is the object, {1} the reason
Import: a record is not saved because its parent on the row was not
labels.value: Not saved, because a record it points at on this row was not saved. Fix that record, then load this row again.

labels.shortDescription: Import: a later row of a key loads nothing because the key's first row failed
labels.value: The first row with this key was not saved, so this row was not loaded. Fix that row, then load these rows again.

labels.shortDescription: Run log: a lookup to a record the file creates; {0} is the field
labels.value: {0}: a value naming a record this file creates is found when the file loads, not in the dry run.

labels.shortDescription: Import: a several-object mapping lists no object
labels.value: Choose at least one object to load.

labels.shortDescription: Import: an object is listed twice; {0} is the object
labels.value: {0} is listed twice. List each object once.

labels.shortDescription: Import: a several-object upload cannot delete
labels.value: A file of several objects cannot delete records. Delete records of one object at a time.

labels.shortDescription: Import: a column maps to an object not loaded; {0} column, {1} object
labels.value: The column {0} is mapped to {1}, which this file does not load. Map the column again.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: a same-row link; {0} child, {1} parent, {2} field
labels.value: Each {0} record is linked to the {1} record on its row through {2}.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: title of the several objects card
Import wizard: what the several objects card loads
labels.value: Load several kinds of record from one file, a sheet for each or several on one row, each linked to the records it points at.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: label of the objects a several-object mapping loads
Import wizard: the objects not chosen yet
Import wizard: help for choosing several objects
labels.value: Choose every object the file loads. A file read above suggests them. Records load parents first, whatever the order here.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the object one sheet loads; {0} is the sheet
Import wizard: the object a text file loads
Import wizard: help for the object of each sheet
labels.value: A heading of the sheet's object maps to its field. A two-part heading, such as Contact.LastName, maps to that object's field on any sheet.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: help for the several objects matching step
labels.value: Choose how each object's rows find their records. Records on one row are linked where one points at another. A record on another sheet is linked by a column that names its parent by ID or by a field you choose.
